items.title: File Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid
items.quote: Dafür haben Sie ab der Zustellung zwei Wochen Zeit (Notfrist).
items.computation: This is a formally served court document (Vollstreckungsbescheid); the letter itself states the actual service date: 'Zugestellt am 23.11.2026 (Datum laut Vermerk des Zustellers)'. For formal delivery the stated date is the delivery day itself, no days are added. Under §339 ZPO / §188 Abs. 2 BGB, a two-week (Notfrist) period starting with service on Monday 23.11.2026 (day of event not counted, §187 Abs. 1 BGB) ends on the day of the second following week bearing the same name as the day of service, i.e. Monday 23.11 + 7 = Monday 30.11, +7 = Monday 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday in Berlin, so under §222 Abs. 2 ZPO/§193 BGB no shift to a later working day is needed. The Einspruch must reach the Amtsgericht Musterwedding in writing by this date.

warnings: This is a formal court order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) following an unanswered Mahnbescheid; missing the two-week Einspruch deadline (07.12.2026) will make the debt legally final and enforceable, so the person should act quickly or verify whether the underlying claim (Exempel Online-Akademie UG, EUR 720,00 course fees) is actually valid and whether the original Mahnbescheid of 12.10.2026 was properly received.
